games.title: Tower of Babel - no mercy
games.synopsis: Tower of Babel is a multiplayer physics-based tower building game. You and your friends will have to build a tower together. But beware! Who makes the tower collapse loses the game. Build with caution then cast magic spells to scupper your friends moves!
games.coop_description: In local coop up to four players can cooperate. There's also an online versus mode where one local team can compete against another.

games.title: TowerFall
games.synopsis: TowerFall is an archery, combat arena game focus mainly on mutliplayer deathmatch. Players must defeat each other with arrows and other power-ups, usually by getting in one direct hit. Participants can review each game's end moments with a gameplay rewind feature. The Nintendo Switch version of the game includes all content from the "Ascension" and "Dark World" expansions, along with some Switch-exclusive characters.
games.coop_description: "Quest Mode" allows up to two players to fight NPC's instead of one another. Basically, this is a standard "horde mode" featured in many modern games. There is friendly fire that can pose a bit of difficulty if players don't communicate well. Different strategies involving ammunition and loot sharing make the game much deeper than you'd expect. The "Dark World" expansion introduces the all-new Dark World Mode - a co-op campaign for 1-4 players. Battle your way to hideous boss monsters, and face the brutal challenge of the added Legendary difficulty mode. Expand your roster of playable…

games.title: Towerborne
games.synopsis: The Belfry stands as a beacon of hope and safety amongst the ruins of humanity and the City of Numbers, with monsters lurking right outside the tower’s walls. You are an Ace, born anew from the spirit realm with the skills, the grit, and the determination to protect the people of the Belfry.
games.coop_description: Venture out of The Belfry with up to three other Aces to vanquish the looming terror that surrounds the tower. Either way, you won’t be alone. Aces can recruit Umbra companions to join them in battle, gaining access to enhanced skills and unique abilities tied to each spirit. After fighting your way through enemies, return to The Belfry to turn in quests, reforge gear, and more.

games.title: Towertale
games.synopsis: Towertale is a 2D, story-driven action game that has a heavy focus on boss battles. Fight your way up the elusive Tower and challenge the bosses of each level. Unveil the mystery that lies up in its peak. Play four different stories and unlock multiple endings. Join Lionel, Faindrel, Lord Snicklefritz and "Dark Echo" in their quest to get to the top! Fast-paced 2D boss battling action. 4 Playable Characters, many different ways to play. 17 Fightable bosses designed with multiple phases. 12 beautifully-crafted levels. 25+ CGs that are used for the storyline. 34+ Music tracks from bosses, characters and story themes. Over 120+ story in game cutscenes. Multiple story endings. Arcade Mode for those who want to play the tower but not the tale! Boss rush mode with leaderboards. Freemode that enables you to fight the bosses at your own pace and difficulty. Steam Achievements. Full controller…
games.coop_description: Play co-op with up to 4 players. Control four different characters and follow their stories. Learn their motivations on coming to the Tower. Each character shows a different perspective. The choices you make on one character may affect what will happen on the others. With a story that intertwines all of their fates, there can only be one who will claim the ultimate prize!

games.title: Toxic Crusaders
games.synopsis: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!
games.coop_description: Up to four players, each taking control of one of the available characters, beat their way through the game together.

games.synopsis: 44 floors await the dolls Pino and Acha filled with obstacles and enemies in this top-down shooter. The goal on each level is to collect four gold hearts.
games.coop_description: Both Pino and Acha can be controlled by a human, helping each other to clear the levels.

games.title: Toy Rhythm Beat
games.synopsis: In Toy Rhythm Beat the arrows climb toward the rings and you mark each one right on the beat: hold one Joy-Con™ controller in each hand and turn your wrist in the direction of the arrow, or play with the control sticks. Simple to learn for little ones, and with a speed slider that turns it into a real challenge for the grown-ups.
games.coop_description: Give one Joy-Con to a friend. The left Joy-Con controller plays the arrows on the left, the right one the arrows on the right.

games.title: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! + Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Double Pack
games.synopsis: Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles. This compilation includes: Toy Story (1995, Sega Genesis, SNES, Game Boy): Play your way through the movie with challenging levels that closely follow the plot of the original film. Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue! (1999, Playstation 1): To infinity and beyond! Control Buzz Lightyear across fifteen levels to rescue Woody in a game that follows the plot of the second film. Toy Story 2 (1999, Game Boy Color): Become…
games.coop_description: Toy Story 3 allows you to play through the game with a friend in local, two player co-op. Available in Story Mode or Toy Box Mode. Video Game News

games.title: Trailblazers
games.synopsis: Trailblazers is a fresh new co-operative racing title with an innovative on-track game mechanic: paint the track, boost on your colour and work as a team to win! Take control of high-speed racers in unique 3v3 team races across a series of colourful circuits. Paint the track as you race, capturing key areas to dynamically change the racing line, then boost on your team's colour to dominate the race!
games.coop_description: Up to three players can race together on the same team in team races against the AI. Work together with your teammates to capture the track! The best teams will share painting and boosting duties, picking complementary drivers to maximize their individual skill-sets. But don’t forget about the opposing team! Paint over their trails to deny them a boost, or save up your paint for aggressive attacks which shock the opposition and disrupt their strategy.

games.title: Train Traffic Manager
games.synopsis: Train Traffic Manager isn't your grandpa's model railway set. Think fast, plan faster, and keep those trains from turning into flaming metal confetti. In this strategy-puzzle game, you're in charge of everything from switches and signals to drawbridges and, oh yeah, preventing cataclysmic train disasters.
games.coop_description: Up to four players work together to solve the levels. Depending on how much stuff there is to control either each player has access to their own bridges, switches & such or the control is shared. Lives and power-ups are shared between all players.

games.title: Trash Sailors
games.synopsis: Trash Sailors is a hand-drawn sailing action with co-op up to 4 players. Control the group of castaways by local or online multiplayer, and create the trashiest sailing team in history! Make your slapdash raft, fight with monsters, and trash your friendship! The world was flooded by a giant Trash Tsunami! Luckily for you, a lot of trash is floating around. Trash is your main resource and the most valuable thing in this world. You can recycle it into fuel, raft spare parts, and even weapons. Brace yourself for swamp crocodiles, toxic sharks, arctic pirates, and much, much more!
games.coop_description: Up to four players on a raft cooperate to collect resources, build stuff and defend against all the enemies coming to get you.

games.title: Trash is Fun
games.synopsis: Embark on an unforgettable journey with your friends around the world in an eco-friendly adventure. You will play as 8 mutated animals: duck, owl, squirrel and hedgehog, and others. After the apocalypse due to global warming, the characters realized that in order to survive, they would have to gather in a team and sort and recycle garbage.
games.coop_description: Up to four players work together to grab and sort the garbage while protecting the machines from zombies.

games.title: Travis Strikes Again: No More Heroes
games.synopsis: Seven years after the events of No More Heroes 2, a former professional baseball player turned assassin named the Badman seeks revenge on Travis Touchdown for murdering his daughter, Bad Girl. When Badman tracks down Travis and attacks him, the two are transported into the demonic "Death Drive MK-II", a video game console created by Dr. Juvenile that was canceled during development. Travis is able to navigate the games within the Death Drive by using a Death Glove that he wears, allowing him to fight against Badman and other antagonists through six different games on the console. Travis and Badman race to defeat each boss character, gaining a Death Ball for each victory; the first that collects all six Death Balls will be granted one wish.
games.coop_description: A second player can join in using a Joy-Con and play as Badman. Players can work together to clear one of the seven games and beat the boss at the end, though only one player will be able to claim the Death Ball and get their wish

games.title: Trials Rising
games.synopsis: Set in new epic locations around the world and featuring more tracks than ever before, Trials Rising lets riders travel the world and put their skills to the test through various levels of difficulty, beat the competition, grow their fame under the eyes of experienced sponsors, and work to become Trials champions. While enjoying the view of the Eiffel Tower or riding along the Great Wall of China, riders won't be able to resist the thrill of astonishing exploits and fails on their way.
games.coop_description: Two riders each contribute 50 percent of the power and balance, and ride together on one bike in Tandem Bike mode

games.title: Tricky Spider
games.synopsis: Move the spider Adanson up and down to avoid the approaching obstacles! The simple but deep operability, such as pressing the button, releasing it, and pressing it finely, becomes addictive.
games.coop_description: Adansons friend can join in and...well also avoid the obstacles for a better score.

games.title: Trigger Witch
games.synopsis: Recalling the visual style and intuitive gameplay of 16-bit action-adventure classics, Trigger Witch puts an ultra-violent spin on cute and colorful pixel art. With a compelling and original narrative, puzzling environments to explore, a dynamic soundtrack, twin-stick shooter mechanics and a vast array of enemies to blast into smithereens, this is a tale that will grip you from start to bloody finish. From the creators of Reverie, Trigger Witch is a stylized 2D twin-stick action game set in an odd open world where magic is outdated and firearms are the new way of life. Players assume the role of Colette, a prospective graduate from the Stock, an academy for Witchcraft and Triggery. After a mysterious man invades her realm, events are set in motion that turn Colette’s life upside-down, casting her as the sole heroine with enough firepower to restore peace.
games.coop_description: A second witch can join in at any time with their own guns (life meter, upgrades, etc.).

games.coop_description: A second witch can join in at any time with their own guns (life meter, upgrades, etc.).

games.title: Trine 2: Complete Story
games.synopsis: Trine 2 is a sidescrolling game of action, puzzles and platforming where you play as one of Three Heroes who make their way through dangers untold in a fantastical fairytale world. Join Amadeus the Wizard, Pontius the Knight and Zoya the Thief in their adventure full of friendship, magic and betrayal. Trine 2: Complete Story features enhanced visuals, new skills, and the Goblin Menace expansion campaign and the all-new unlockable Dwarven Caverns level.
games.coop_description: A side-scrolling puzzle-platforming game featuring up to three players working together to complete the campaign. Three player couch co-op, online co-op, and combo co-op (i.e., a mix of couch and online co-op) is supported throughout the campaign. Each player controls one of the three heroes.

games.title: Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power
games.synopsis: Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power is a 3D platforming game of action, puzzles and adventure. The heroes try to return their extraordinary gifts to the Artifact called Trine, and so they meddle with powers beyond their understanding: Trine shatters, and a heartless ancient sorcerer escapes. With only a broken artifact to guide them, the heroes must try and repair the damage they've caused... or the damage that might yet be done.
games.coop_description: A side-scrolling puzzle-platforming game featuring up to three players with different abilities working together to complete the campaign.

games.title: Trine 4: The Nightmare Prince
games.synopsis: The Trine series returns to the magic of 2.5D with Trine 4: The Nightmare Prince! The three heroes are back, sent on a quest to retrieve the troubled young Prince Selius. Amadeus the Wizard, Pontius the Knight, and Zoya the Thief are joined together once again on a quest through fantastical fairytale landscapes teeming with danger. Prince Selius suffers from intensely dark dreams and, due to his magical talents, monstrous nightmares are able to slip into reality and wreak havoc on the waking world. Amadeus, Pontius, and Zoya must find the afflicted prince and resolve the desperate situation before the world is engulfed by the Nightmare Prince's shadows.
games.coop_description: Play through the entire campaign with up to four players locally (couch co-op), online, or a mix of the two (combo co-op).

games.title: Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy
games.synopsis: The Trine series is back with its biggest adventure! In their fifth outing, the Heroes of Trine are pitted against dastardly and duplicitous villains, who will stop at nothing to seize control of the kingdom. The clock is ticking to save the world of Trine!
games.coop_description: Play through the entire campaign with up to four players locally (couch co-op), online, or a mix of the two (combo co-op).

games.title: Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy
games.synopsis: The Trine series is back with its biggest adventure! In their fifth outing, the Heroes of Trine are pitted against dastardly and duplicitous villains, who will stop at nothing to seize control of the kingdom. The clock is ticking to save the world of Trine!
games.coop_description: Play through the entire campaign with up to four players locally (couch co-op), online, or a mix of the two (combo co-op).

games.title: Trine: Enchanted Edition
games.synopsis: Trine Enchanted Edition is the origin story for the three unlikely heroes of Trine - Amadeus the Wizard, Pontius the Knight, and Zoya the Thief. Spellbound by the magical object Trine, the heroes must join forces to overcome obstacles and puzzles in a fully interactive physics-based world, battle the undead and their minions, and restore balance to the kingdom! It's the first game in the trilogy but with improved graphics based on the Trine 2 engine and with mid-level saving.
games.coop_description: The players take control of one of the three characters and solve the puzzle together.

games.title: Trine: Ultimate Collection
games.synopsis: Trine: Ultimate Collection is a compilation of: Trine: Enchanted Edition Trine 2: Complete Story Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power Trine 4: The Nightmare Prince
games.coop_description: The players take control of one of the three characters and solve the puzzle together.

games.title: Trinity Trigger
games.synopsis: Trinity Trigger is an action role-playing game combining the look and feel of iconic RPGs of the ‘90s with an emphasis on fast-paced, customizable combat. Players take control of three young heroes as they attempt to defy fate and save the continent of Trinitia. Accompanying them are the Triggers, strange creatures with the unique ability to transform into eight types of weapons that players must master if they hope to be successful on their quest. Whether playing alone or with up to two friends via local co-op, explore diverse biomes and dungeons, strategize to exploit enemy weaknesses, and change your destiny!
games.coop_description: Sit down with two of your friends (up to three players) to experience the adventure together. Co-op unlocks once you've recruited all three characters. And only player 1 is able to open chests or talk to NPCs.

games.title: Troll and I
games.synopsis: After a disaster destroys his village, a young boy named Otto is forced to run, leaving his family and friends behind to fend for himself in a harsh, demanding landscape. But in the midst of chaos and from the desire to survive, Otto befriends a Troll. Together they embark on a journey that explores the friendship and emotional depth of human and beast as they trek across a devastated landscape that has concealed many secrets...until now!
games.coop_description: Players control one of the two main characters, a young boy named Otto and a magical Troll. Both characters are unique and have their own ways of overcoming obstacles.

games.title: Trollhunters: Defenders of Arcadia
games.synopsis: ump into the world of Trollhunters as Jim Lake Jr. to stop Porgon the Trickster Troll and his sneaky plans! Team up with Claire in couch co-op and also get a helping hand from lots more loved characters to face unknown evil forces and help stop the Time-pocalypse! Upgrade your armour and boost your abilities to become more powerful than ever. The fate of the universe is in your hands!
games.coop_description: The second player can take over the control of Claire at any time.

games.title: Trombone Champ
games.synopsis: Honk, blow, & toot your way through over 45 songs, collect all 50 unique Tromboner Cards, and uncover the mysteries of the Trombiverse. Do you have what it takes to become the true Trombone Champ?
games.coop_description: Up to four players can play through a song together to get a new high score.

games.title: Troubleshooter
games.synopsis: Troubleshooter is a top-down arcade shooter. Fight through endless waves of unsuspecting dinosaurs and prove you are the best!
games.coop_description: Grab a friend and rampage together.

games.title: Truxton Extreme
games.synopsis: Take down hordes of alien invaders with your Power Shot, Truxton Beam, Thunder Laser, Homing Shot, Star‑mine Shot, and more! Don't forget to breathe as you face off against gigantic bosses in the ultimate battle for humanity’s survival!
games.coop_description: Team mode lets you play together with a friend and share your lives and score.

games.title: Tunche
games.synopsis: Tunche is a charming, hand-drawn beat'em up hack and slash game with roguelike elements, co-op, and a pinch of shaman witchcraft. Choose one of the five characters, master their skill-sets and ultimate abilities defeat epic bosses, and unravel the secrets of the mysterious Amazonian jungle! The game is centered around high-risk, high-reward combat, and features a 'stylish' grade system. Choose a hero that suits your playstyle the most and begin your journey through 4 different worlds, each filled with unique enemies.
games.coop_description: Team up with up to 4 friends in local co-op!

games.title: Turnip Mountain
games.synopsis: Turnip Mountain is a physics-based climbing adventure in which you control each hand independently using two mice or two analogue sticks. Grab, swing and launch yourself to the summit your own way.
games.coop_description: Share the challenge with a friend, with each player controlling just one arm.

games.synopsis: TurtlePop: Journey to Freedom is a platform puzzle game that introduces Bebo, Deephi, Slimmie, Smarts, Willis and Sparky the Turtle. Guide your turtles through a variety of fun and challenging game worlds in a bid to help rescue other turtles and lead them to freedom. Need help? You can always tap on ‘The Genie’, a friendly airborne support turtle that you can use to manipulate the game world and enhance the abilities of the turtles!
games.coop_description: Free the turtles together with a friend in over 100 stages across seven game world.

games.title: Twin Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Adventure
games.synopsis: Twin Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Adventure is a story-driven brick breaking game molded in the style of ‘80s arcade classics like Arkanoid and Breakout, but with a plot, characters, and meaning! Featuring 40 stages, four boss fights, New Game+, multiple extra features, plenty of story and dialogue, collectibles, a rocking soundtrack, and a fun achievement system, Twin Breaker is an ode to both the past and the future.
games.coop_description: A second player with his own paddle joins in and helps break the bricks.

games.title: Twin Robots: Ultimate Edition
games.synopsis: Watt and Volt are two twin robots, who have been forgotten by time and abandoned in an old robot factory. Marked as defective by mistake, if they wish to prove themselves as deserving a place in today’s world, they must pass a series of grueling tests. You'll be running, jumping & solving puzzles together, but beware: Both robots are battery-powered so they consume energy in everything they do! Watch out for their battery levels! You can also transfer energy from one robot to the other so that both can safely reach the exit. What’s new in Ultimate Edition? 12 new levels, making a total of 40 levels in the game. New exclusive music tracks by Levi Bond Improved physics! Some puzzles have been tuned & reworked New camera system Secret bonus zones Improved graphics, including new full 3D backgrounds and better overall performance. Reworked achievement system, removing grinding achievements
games.coop_description: Two player couch co-op is fully supported, so as long as you have a friend to control the other robot, the only thing you'll need to focus on, is what your own robot is doing.

games.coop_description: Up to four players team up to complete all the levels together. Everyone controls a (color-swapped) cat.

games.title: TwinBee
games.synopsis: A cartoon-themed vertically scrolling shoot 'em up where players earn power-ups by shooting bells.
games.coop_description: Player 1 controls TwinBee while Player 2 controls WinBee. Players can align their ships vertically or horizontally together to perform more powerful attacks.

games.title: Twins of Legacy
games.synopsis: Play as a talented painter and a skilled musician, combining art and music to navigate through a world full of mysteries and challenges. Together, these two heroes will use their abilities to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and uncover secrets across 20 thrilling levels and 3 distinct themes.
games.coop_description: One of the twins can be controlled by another player to puzzle your way through the game together.

games.title: Twins of the Sun
games.synopsis: A colorful co-op adventure where you take on enemies with power-ups and clever tricks. Travel through diverse lands to rescue your sister in a story anyone can enjoy.
games.coop_description: invite a friend and complete the entire campaign together, sharing combat and exploration.

games.coop_description: invite a friend and complete the entire campaign together, sharing combat and exploration.

games.title: Twisted Metal
games.synopsis: This release is enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters. From the creator of Twisted Metal and God of War, Twisted Metal is back only on the PlayStation 3 system. Developed by the original team credited with carving out a new gaming genre, Eat Sleep Play, founded by David Jaffe and Scott Campbell, unleashes Twisted Metal onto the PS3 with a devilishly pure experience and a whole new look that is deeper, and madder than ever before.
games.coop_description: Two players can team up locally via split screen and play through the main story mode.

games.title: Twisted Metal 2
games.synopsis: Twisted Metal 2 adds more playable characters and weapons to the series as the various cars attempt to battle their way to the evil Calypso for glory and prizes.
games.coop_description: Play through the game with a friend as over the top cars hell bent on destruction.

games.title: Twisted Metal 3
games.synopsis: Experience Twisted Metal 3 originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters. Welcome to our twisted world where the drivers are insane, the explosions apocalyptic and the weapons hard-core nasty. It’s the original and ultimate automotive combat experience! Get twisted with high powered vehicles, an arsenal of weapons and unbeatable bosses!
games.coop_description: Team up in co-op to take down enemy vehicles.

games.title: Twisted Metal 4
games.synopsis: New characters, weapons and vehicles including customization-options otherwise the same old destroy everyone car combat the series is known for.
games.coop_description: Play through the game with a friend as over the top cars hell bent on destruction.

games.title: Two Crude Dudes
games.synopsis: It's 2020, and a slew of nuclear explosions has rendered New York City a smoldering heap. The city has issued an ordinance that no one can enter or exit the contaminated city. High above, in the lone remaining skyscraper, a mad scientist is conducting experiments on helpless, mutated victims, transforming them into killing machines. The government has hired you on as a mercenary to exterminate the hordes of gun-wielding beasts that are polluting the city no small task, to be certain. Luckily, you have a partner, and together you are known as Two Crude Dudes. Pick up enemies, weapons, and other objects, then throw them, utilize them, or just crush them to bits. Cool graphics and sound effects make this one powerful experience.
games.coop_description: You and one other dude gang up to fight mutants in New York City.

games.title: U.S. Championship V'Ball
games.synopsis: Control two young men as they enter a beach volleyball tournament and aim for the championship. Enjoy a variety of actions, such as controlling where the ball flies during serves and spikes, or delivering a more powerful spike by tapping rapidly.
games.coop_description: A second player can jump in and take control of the other character on your team to take on the AI together.

games.title: U.S. Championship V'Ball

games.synopsis: UFO 50 is a collection of 50 single and multiplayer games from the creators of Spelunky, Downwell, and Catacomb Kids. Explore a variety of genres, from platformers and shoot 'em ups to puzzle games, roguelites, and RPGs. Our goal is to combine a familiar 8-bit aesthetic with new ideas and modern game design.
games.coop_description: The exact details of which games will support co-op, and how many players, has not been detailed yet. We'll update this as more information becomes available

games.title: UNSIGHTED
games.synopsis: After a long war with the humans, the few androids that remain in Arcadia are running out of Anima, the energy that gives all robots consciousness. It's up to you, Alma, to find a way to recover your memories and save your friends from becoming UNSIGHTED. Explore the vast ruins of Arcadia, using every tool you can find. Time is ticking. They need you, Alma.
games.coop_description: A second player can join in and help Alma on her journey.

games.title: UORiS DX
games.synopsis: UORiS has become DX (Deluxe) and reborn! Redesigned as it is cute. There are more types of fish blocks, and a mysterious huge block has appeared!? The rules are simple, just align them side by side and erase them. However, when the head disappears, all the body except the line also disappears. In the empty place, the upper block falls down and it is possible to erase the chain.
games.coop_description: The game offers a co-operative mode in which two players fill up the same play field together.

games.title: USAAF Mustang
games.synopsis: Players pilot a plane and take on enemy squadrons. Use power-up items to enhance your weapons and gain the advantage as you clear stages. The key to victory is the "STRIKE FORCER" attack, which makes you temporarily invincible in a pinch while continuing your attacks on enemies.
games.coop_description: A second plane can join in at any time and help fight the bad guys.

games.title: UTOPIA 9 - A Volatile Vacation
games.synopsis: Utopia 9 – A Volatile Vacation is a rogue-like 3D twin stick shooter. The game is set in a tragicomic future with a retro sci-fi feel. You play as the most recent guest to arrive on the vacation resort Utopia 9 but nothing is as promised! Upon arrival, you must make your way through hordes of space mutants determined to take you out and snatch your loot. The nemesis system adds unique enemies and invites the player to take revenge on the mutant murderers! Can you survive the mutant onslaught and sue the travel agency?
games.coop_description: Two players team up locally to take on space mutants and try to make the best out of a bad vacation

games.title: UglyDolls: An Imperfect Adventure
games.synopsis: An Imperfect Adventure, a whole horde of robots are on the loose and taking over Uglyville trying to make it “perfect!”. What is wrong with that, you might ask? Uglyville is a sweet neighbourhood where everything is a little off. The townsfolk are all uniquely different and embrace each other for their differences. Control Moxy or Ox and team up with fellow UglyDolls Babo, Ice Bat, Wage, and Ugly Dog to explore Uglyville with procedurally generated streets that make every game different.
games.coop_description: Team up with a friend on your couch to play as two of the UglyDolls and save Uglyville from the horde of robots

games.title: Ultra Mega Xtra Party Challenge
games.synopsis: A party game featuring 100 minigames inspired by the likes of WarioWare.
games.coop_description: In co-op mode, the AI is trying to defeat the active player by adding some disturbances in minigames. Other players have to shake they joy-cons, mash buttons and more to remove the disturbances.

games.title: Ultra Street Fighter II: The Final Challengers
games.synopsis: The newest iteration of SFII in nearly 10 years, Ultra Street Fighter II features all of the classic characters, a host of new single player and multiplayer features, as well as two new fighters: Evil Ryu and Violent Ken! Nintendo Switch TV, Tabletop and Handheld modes allow you to play Ultra Street Fighter II at home or on-the-go!
games.coop_description: Co-Op Battle: In this new mode, players can join forces in teams of two as they battle together against a computer-controlled opponent. Players share a health bar and can coordinate attacks to perform powerful combos.

games.title: Undead Battle Royale
games.synopsis: Mow down zombies and top the scoreboard in co-op/competitive multiplayer survival gameplay! An extensive arsenal of weapons and a thirst for zombie blood are all that stand between you and a grisly demise in the pick-up-and-play action of Undead Battle Royale! The undead have risen. Civilisation has fallen. Now only one person can bring humanity back from the brink: you! Survive the onslaught, slaughter your foes, and seize victory!
games.coop_description: Work together to exterminate your undead foes!

games.title: Under Defeat
games.synopsis: Under Defeat is a vertically scrolling shooter where you control a helicopter capable of moving in eight directions. It's a sleek, streamlined experience with just two buttons—fire and bomb—making it easy to pick up but hard to master. What sets the game apart is the tilt mechanic: as you turn, your shots tilt slightly left or right, allowing for strategic, angled attacks. You also have a small, satellite-like option unit that shoots independently. However, charging it requires you to release the fire button for a while, creating a tactical ebb and flow rarely seen in this all-out shoot 'em up genre. There’s a big difference between an arcade game and one you play at home, and Under Defeat has gotten several new additions since its arcade debut in 2005. The New Order Mode adapts the game to a modern 16:9 format, and the game has received both sharper textures and four soundtracks. This…
games.coop_description: A second player can jump in at any time and play through the game with you.

games.synopsis: Undercat is a 2D action platformer where you play as a rebellious dog who is tired of catkind’s tyranny. Catch cats and shake out all their coins and use them to buy items. Throw stuff at your enemies and be shot from a cannon. Solve puzzles and end the cat tyranny once and for all.
games.coop_description: Two dogs can play together and fight all the cats.

games.title: Underling Uprising
games.synopsis: Underling Uprising features modern Beat 'Em Up gameplay mixed with inspirations from nostalgic '90s cartoons . Fight across the world as the Underlings, a group of scientifically enhanced experiments, each with their own unique powers. You only have one mission at hand: Stop the mad scientist that created you!
games.coop_description: Play through the game with up to three friends. They all control one of the available characters.

games.title: Unit 4
games.synopsis: An evil alien army has stolen the sacred artifact of our heroes tribe while invading their home planet. Similar reports are coming from other planets and the solar system will decay without the power of these artifacts. Our heroes will begin an epic journey to uncover the truth behind this invasion. Who are these aliens? What are they trying to accomplish? Can our heroes recover the artifacts before their entire solar system starts to collapse? Experience the ultimate old-school platforming mayhem: perform impossible tricks, play with your friends and get ready to save the universe!
games.coop_description: Players select one of four different characters, each one with its own unique skill: Agility, Strength, Engineering, and Mysticism. Work together to combine abilities and save the galaxy

games.title: Unrailed 2: Back on Track
games.synopsis: Unrailed 2: Back on Track brings chaotic local and online multiplayer track-building action to the next level – band together with friends to collaborate and build your track across new procedurally generated worlds - WHILST the train is running! So think fast, with more freedom than ever before, and conquer new obstacles in your way - before your trains becomes… a trainwreck!
games.coop_description: Up to four players can team up to work their way through the story mode.

games.coop_description: Up to four players can team up to work their way through the story mode.

games.title: Unrailed!
games.synopsis: Unrailed! is a co-op multiplayer game where you have to work together with your friends to build a train track across endless procedurally generated worlds. Master random encounters with its inhabitants, upgrade your train, and keep it from derailing!
games.coop_description: Up to four players can team up locally (couch co-op) or online to build tracks and keep the train from derailing

games.title: Unravel Two
games.synopsis: When you cut ties to the past, new bonds form. In Unravel Two, create a Yarny of your very own. Then build relationships with other Yarnys in local co-op or as a single player, fostering friendship and support as you journey together. Begin your adventure in a cold and imposing land, then watch your surroundings blossom with new life as you chase the spark of adventure. Dive into an immersive story filled with energy, exuberance, inspiration – even monsters. Approach every challenge with positivity and fearlessness to awaken the world around you, and discover an unbreakable bond between friends.
games.coop_description: The second player takes control of the blue Yarny as both players traverse landscapes and enjoy the journey together

games.title: Unruly Heroes
games.synopsis: The sacred scroll preserving harmony in our world has been torn up and scattered to the winds. Now, strange and terrifying creatures are sowing discord and chaos throughout the land.Only four totally opposed, implausible heroes can turn back the tide: Sanzang the wise, Wukong the fearless monkey, Kihong the greedy pig, and Sandmonk the sensitive brute. On their journey westward, they will travel to fantastical worlds to gather the pieces of the scroll and fight an army of evil creatures. Or they'll try, anyway!
games.coop_description: The game can be played in coop up to 4 players with each player controlling one of the four heroes

games.title: Until The Last Bullet
games.synopsis: Until The Last Bullet is a unique combination of an FMV and rail-shooter game in which you navigate the winding halls of an abandoned factory, eliminating waves of bloodthirsty mutants using various weapons you find throughout the game. The dynamic gameplay is enhanced by short, humorous film clips featuring actors.
games.coop_description: Shoot the mutants with a friend.

games.title: Untitled Goose Game
games.synopsis: Untitled Goose Game is a slapstick-stealth-sandbox, where you are a goose let loose on an unsuspecting village. Make your way around town, from peoples' back gardens to the high street shops to the village green, setting up pranks, stealing hats, honking a lot, and generally ruining everyone’s day.
games.coop_description: The game offers a local two-player cooperative mode where you can terrorize everyone together.

games.title: Unturned
games.synopsis: You're a survivor in the zombie infested ruins of society, and must work with your friends and forge alliances to remain among the living.
games.coop_description: Up to 24 Players can team up and work together to stay unturned. Especially on official servers however, PVP is not deactivated so griefing is still possible. The console releases also allow to team up in local split-screen multiplayer with a friend. While Unturned is intended to be cooperative and the overall goal is still working with friends in a story based atmosphere - there are players that may want to ruin that due to griefing. As of now, there is no way to disable distinct PvP content. ×

games.title: Upin & Ipin Universe
games.synopsis: Step into the first-ever open-world adventure based on Upin & Ipin , the global animated phenomenon. Developed in collaboration between Les’ Copaque Production , the original creators of the beloved series, this is the official game world of Kampung Durian Runtuh —brought to life like never before. Upin & Ipin Universe is a joyful, seamless open-world experience that captures the wonder of growing up in a Southeast Asian village—where every bridge, trail, rooftop, and warung is crafted with authenticity by a team who lived it. In Malay, “ kampung ” means “village”—and here, it means freedom, curiosity, and heart .
games.coop_description: Team up in local split-screen co-op. The second player seemlessly takes control of the second twin.

games.title: Urban Flow
games.synopsis: The rules are very simple – change the traffic lights, and do not let cars crash into each other. Manage the city’s stoplights and special vehicles to try to avoid the chaos! Become the best traffic control officer in history!
games.coop_description: Play by yourself or with your friends in scalable “drop-in, drop-out” local co-op mode for two, three, or four players! If a level has at least as many traffic lights as there are players, then every player will control their own light(s). When a level has less lights than the total number of players, two players will share control of the same light. Lives and power-ups are shared between all players.

When a level has less lights than the total number of players, two players will share control of the same light. Lives and power-ups are shared between all players.

games.title: Uurnog Uurnlimited
games.synopsis: Enter the wacky & whimsical world of Uurnog Uurnlimited , where you have only one goal: find your way around the world, and steal all the animals! Why? Because they’re adorable, and because video games. Uurnog Uurnlimited is a delightfully silly 2D platformer inspired by games like Super Mario Bros. 2, Lyle in Cube Sector, and Dyad. Play single-player or co-op, explore the world through its many mysterious doors, solve puzzles and gather the items and animals needed in your Save Room. Careful though — the Save Room also saves your mistakes (urr nurr!)
games.coop_description: A second player can join in playing as some kind of creature that is tethered to the main character.

games.title: VASARA Collection
games.synopsis: Science Fiction meets History in these arcade classics which take place in an alternate timeline Feudal Japan where technologically advanced weaponry and equipment are a reality, and heroes use flying motorcycles with amazing firepower and fierce melee weapons to destroy their enemies. Fight against warships, battle tanks, giant robots, evil soldiers and rogue Samurais to prevent 1600's Japan from being taken over by tyrannical forces. Try and stay alive in this frantic game where everyone, and everything, is out to kill you! The VASARA Collection includes both games (VASARA and VASARA 2), support for widescreen and vertical (tate) modes, and the new Timeless Mode, which is a continuous mode with a procedural generated scenario in 3D and widescreen format.
games.coop_description: Drop-in/drop-out couch co-op is supported in the main modes of VASARA and VASARA 2 (two players max), and in the new Timeless Mode (four players max)

games.title: VISCO Collection
games.synopsis: VISCO Collection is a nostalgia-packed bundle of seven classic arcade games, each revitalized and enhanced for today's gamers. Whether you're a fan of shoot 'em ups, racing, shooters, or sports simulations, this collection has something for everyone. Included are the following games (those with co-op are marked in bold and italic): Andro Dunos (2 players) Band Bead Captain Tomaday (2 players) FlipShot Ganryu Goal! Goal! Goal! Neo Drift Out: New Technology
games.coop_description: Andro Dunos and Captain Tomaday (both shoot'em ups) allow for a friend to jump in and play through the game together.

games.coop_description: Andro Dunos and Captain Tomaday (both shoot'em ups) allow for a friend to jump in and play through the game together.

games.title: VVVVVV
games.synopsis: It’s the game that’ll have you walking on the ceiling and looking up at the floor! VVVVVV is a challenging 2D action/platformer with one deceptively simple gameplay mechanic: Without the ability to jump, Captain Viridian must rely on inverting gravity to advance through hundreds of rooms and solve the puzzles he encounters therein. This love letter to the days of 8-bit home computer games features amazing retro gameplay, a genuinely classic visual aesthetic and an earworm chiptune soundtrack created by Swedish musician Magnus Palsson.
games.coop_description: Two players try to get through the levels together. If a player dies, he respawns once the next checkpoint is triggered.

games.title: Vaccine Rebirth
games.synopsis: Find a vaccine for your infected friend before the time runs out, but be aware your friend will relapse sooner or later and you will have to find a new vaccine in a new randomly rebuilt house. Vaccine is a new approach on Survival Horrors inspired by those of the 90s. You can choose between the two members of a special bio-hazard rapid response team, each starting with their own unique differential abilities. They are trapped in a strange house populated by dangerous mutated creatures, they will have to find a vaccine for another team member who is infected with a deadly virus. Vaccine Rebirth has been built from scratch, expanding the original idea, including new gameplay mechanics, enemies, locations, weapons and much more!
games.coop_description: Team up with a friend in local couch co-op mode, forging an alliance against the malevolent forces that haunt the forsaken premises.

games.title: Vaccine Rebirth

games.coop_description: Team up with a friend in local couch co-op mode, forging an alliance against the malevolent forces that haunt the forsaken premises.

games.title: Vagante
games.synopsis: Vagante is an adventure set in a dark fantasy world filled with monsters, demons, and crooks. Despite these dangers, adventurers commonly travel these unforgiving lands questing for fame, riches, and power. A recent rumor has it that a certain cave at the edge of the woods guards an unfathomable treasure. While a handful of intrepid adventurers have ventured into the cave already, none have returned. Undeterred by the potential danger, you set out by caravan to investigate..
games.coop_description: Adventure cooperatively with up to four players, either locally or online!

games.title: Vampire Survivors
games.synopsis: Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! Vampire Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at you.
games.coop_description: In co-op mode, you can either continue your current game or start a new adventure. It is also possible to seamlessly switch between single and co-op play between stages, unlock achievements, etc.

games.title: Vampire Survivors
games.synopsis: Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! Vampire Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at you.
games.coop_description: In co-op mode, you can either continue your current game or start a new adventure. It is also possible to seamlessly switch between single and co-op play between stages, unlock achievements, etc.

games.title: Vandyke
games.synopsis: Players use weapons including swords, boomerangs, bombs, and flails to defeat enemies and bosses as they progress. Your character will also gain attack power and strike a heroic pose when you pick up meat items, so be sure to use these to your advantage!
games.coop_description: A second warrior in blue pants can join in at any time and help fight everyone.

games.title: Varion
games.synopsis: Varion is a 3D arcade-action top-down “brawler” , featuring couch multiplayer battles for 1 to 4 players. Set in a futuristic universe, it allows the players to control robots fighting in a infinite amount of booby-trapped, procedurally generated arenas during restless, fast-paced battles.
games.coop_description: Dungeon mode allows players to face hordes of increasingly dangerous bots in order to unlock new environments, sharpen their skills and beat their hi-scores.

games.title: Vectronom
games.synopsis: Feel like solving three-dimensional riddles to a frenetic electronic soundtrack? Let Vectronom inject its colorful madness into your life! It’s easy to get into the groove but can you stick to the beat? A CAPTIVATING ATMOSPHERE Welcome to the psychedelic world of Vectronom: experience waves of color and a pulsing geometric path that changes with the beat... All set to a hypnotic electronic soundtrack. There’s only one thing to do: turn up the volume and go with the flow. SOLVE PUZZLES AT THE SPEED OF SOUND Find your path through an ever-changing world, keeping the rhythm with every move you make. Think it sounds easy? The highly intuitive and addictive gameplay will keep you moving through daunting challenges... But how long will you last when the challenges get trickier and trickier? Better play to find out!
games.coop_description: Up to four friends can join up, each one controlling their own cube and trying to solve the level. Once a cube reaches the finish, the level counts as completed and everyone switches to the next one.

games.title: Vendetta
games.synopsis: Vendetta follows the basic Double Dragon formula, but totally goes over the top with it. Wacky characters, a huge variety of weapons, seriously disturbing bosses, and strippers with whips all combine for a... unique gaming experience.
games.coop_description: Four players can drop in at any time and take on those punks (again).

games.title: Vengeance Hunters
games.synopsis: Vengeance Hunters is an adrenaline fueled Neo-Geo hardware developed beat’em’up that lets you and a friend in local co-op fight mutants, zombies, punks, gangsters, lab techs with bombs (you read that correctly), suited mystery men, cyborgs and more across multiple stages, sublevels and secret areas.
games.coop_description: Play through the game with a friend. The combat system, with its aerial attacks, combos and juggling will have you both helping your teammate OR stealing their glory by trying to finish their opponent!

games.title: Vengeance Hunters

games.coop_description: Play through the game with a friend. The combat system, with its aerial attacks, combos and juggling will have you both helping your teammate OR stealing their glory by trying to finish their opponent!

games.title: Vertical Drop Heroes HD
games.synopsis: Vertical Drop Heroes HD is a vertical scrolling, procedurally generated, platformer-RPG hybrid. The game generates three random heroes - based on all the weapons, upgrades and skills you've unlocked in previous playthroughs - from which to choose before setting off an adventure to tackle a series of levels, enemies, bosses, and other challenges.
games.coop_description: Vertical Drop Heroes HD supports two players locally

games.title: Very Very Valet
games.synopsis: 1 to 4 players control an "elite" team of puppet valets, working together to overcome any and all valet-related challenges. It's going to take teamwork and a certain "just park it anywhere" mentality to save the world from a severe parking crisis! It's not enough to just be a valet - be a VERY VERY VALET.
games.coop_description: Valet alone or with friends! Up to four players can work together to solve this severe parking shortage. Help each other and hitch a ride, or cause chaos launching your fellow valets wildly - the choice is yours!

games.title: Very Very Valet

games.coop_description: Valet alone or with friends! Up to four players can work together to solve this severe parking shortage. Help each other and hitch a ride, or cause chaos launching your fellow valets wildly - the choice is yours!

games.title: Victor Vran: Overkill Edition
games.synopsis: Victor Vran is an isometric Action-RPG with a massive selection of weapons, items, outfits, demon powers and destiny cards. Experience intense combat action with dozens of enemies attacking you from all sides and unleash powerful skills to finish them off! Victor Vran lets you decide how to play the game. Forge your own personal version of Victor thanks to a vast array of powerful weapons, game-changing outfits, wicked demon powers and destiny cards. Use special moves, combine skills and weapons to wipe out hordes of hideous beasts and clever boss monsters. In Victor Vran: Overkill Edition players and fans can experience the original all-action game in full, alongside the ethereal Fractured Worlds – a challenging and empowering new chapter in the story of Victor Vran, and Motörhead: Through the Ages – a wild tour through the mythos, music and attitude of the loudest band in the world.
games.coop_description: Slaying demons doesn't have to be a lonely affair - team up with a buddy locally, or up to three friends online and explore the story of the dark world together in a full co-op experience.

games.title: Vinebound: Tangled Together
games.synopsis: Vinebound is a chaotic Horde-Survival Roguelite Co-Op game for 1-2 players where you must coordinate, share attacks and build plantastic arsenals to survive botanical onslaughts of moldy armies, all while tied to your pal by a magical vine. Team up properly and your bond can be your greatest weapon!
games.coop_description: You and your friend are connected together. Both of you must face the challenges together and try to find a way to untangle yourselves. Because of that, you can neither get too far away nor get too close to each other, making this task even more complicated. Additionally, both share Cooldown Flowers that represent the attacks you will perform. The Flowers move from one player to another, and when it reaches a character, he executes the respective attack and sends the Flower back to the other friend, thus creating an innovative " Ping-Pong Cooldown " system, where players must position…

games.title: Viper Phase 1
games.synopsis: In 2050 a group of rebels tries to conquer Earth. To repell them, Operation Viper Phase 1 is created and you are part of it. Flying a space fighter, the game features eight stages full of enemies and bosses to conquer. The original version was quickly replaced by an updated release in August 1995 featuring several gameplay changes like removing the limited ammunition for the secondary weapons. In the US this release was called "Viper Phase 1: USA". This release features both versions.
games.coop_description: A second player can jump in at any time with their own ship and help you fight through the game.

games.title: Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party?
games.synopsis: Collect cards and build your own deck to shape your strategy and progress through your adventure. Your cards are managed as a deck, with a hand drawn each battle and limits on how many cards you can play. Roll the dice and journey through a miniature world in this highly replayable board game RPG. Movement, events, and battles are driven by your choices—and a bit of luck.
games.coop_description: Up to three players create their characters and go on a quest together.

games.title: Vitamin Connection
games.synopsis: Prepare for a huge dose of fun in a microscopic world — either solo or together with a partner! Step into the roles of Vita-Boy & Mina-Girl, co-piloting the Capsule Ship to wipe out vile pathogens from within the body of a host. Using innovative controls, you’ll zap down foes with your Vitamin Beam, brandish the ship's handy claw module, and twist and turn through colorful, maze-like environments to save the members of the Sable family — including the dog! — from an assortment of hazardous and increasingly wacky predicaments. Every stage also features variety-packed sub-games that will have you tilting, grabbing, and dancing your way to victory! When playing together, coordination is key, as one player holds the Joy-Con™ controller vertically to move and shoot, and the other holds the Joy-Con horizontally to rotate and aim. Only by forming a connection and harnessing the vitamin power…
games.coop_description: Team up with a friend in the asymmetric two-player mode.

games.title: Void Raiders
games.synopsis: Dive into the exhilarating world of Void Raiders, a turn-based Sci-Fi tabletop strategy game that challenges you and your friends to battle fierce aliens and formidable robots on your quest to journey home through treacherous space stations and mysterious portals. This game combines strategic thinking with cooperative gameplay, offering an immersive experience that is unique every time you play.
games.coop_description: Team up with friends, taking turns, to tackle challenges together, combining your skills and strategies for maximum impact.

games.title: Volley Pals
games.synopsis: Volley Pals is an adrenaline-packed modern style arcade volleyball game with different mechanics in each of its levels. It is a local multiplayer party game that supports up to 4 people.
games.coop_description: Two human players can play against 1-2 bots in individual 2v1 and 2v2 matches.

games.title: Volley Pals
games.synopsis: Volley Pals is an adrenaline-packed modern style arcade volleyball game with different mechanics in each of its levels. It is a local multiplayer party game that supports up to 4 people.
games.coop_description: Two human players can play against 1-2 bots in individual 2v1 and 2v2 matches.

games.title: Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire
games.synopsis: Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire is an action-farming-roguelite filled with whimsical flora and mischievous creatures that want to ruin your dark, vampiric plans of… going vegan! To conquer your bloodlusting hunger you’ll need to tap into all your skills, a bit of magic, and a whole lot of veggies! It’s not so easy to substitute those juicy human necks. You play as Voltaire, the lastborn son of Dracula, aided by your uncles Frank and Stein, who are accomplices in your attempt to prove that bloodsucking is not the only way to thrive in this creepy, cute, hand-drawn world.
games.coop_description: When one Vampire is not enough to handle the farm: Call a second one to help.

games.title: Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire

games.coop_description: When one Vampire is not enough to handle the farm: Call a second one to help.

games.title: Vortex Attack EX
games.synopsis: The alien war machines caught us by surprise. A strange energy vortex appeared near colony Vehar-12, then they came, swarming from the centre of the vortex. The vortices had seemed all but indestructible. But now we have hope. Our technicians patched together a captured war machine and discovered the key to the vortices, a new kind of energy they've dubbed 'Lumergy'. Using our modified war machine we can collect the Lumergy, and reverse its energy to collapse a vortex, destroying the swarm within. We have only one chance at this, only one ship. Your only mission: Destroy the vortices. Save all of us.
games.coop_description: Players team up to close as many "vortices" as possible by killing enemies and collecting their energy. Battle as long as possible to achieve a high score. New ships are unlocked through game play

games.title: Voxel Galaxy
games.synopsis: Voxel Galaxy is set in a near-future world that is a blend of space and cyberpunk. Use various weapons and equipment to take out your enemies in this easy-to-play action game. On the planet Voxel that resides in the far reaches of space, a rebel army struggles in their battle with the Voxel Empire who are plotting to rule the Milky Way itself. The fighting grows more intense by the day...
games.coop_description: Stand up to the menace from the stars with 2 and 4 players! Work together with other players in battles where even a single mistake could mean victory or defeat.

games.title: Voxel Pirates
games.synopsis: Compete for control of the seven seas with yer mateys in wild cooperative battles! Voxel Pirates is a simple pick-up-and-play action game where you defeat enemies with a variety of weapons in an adorably quirky fantasy world of toys. A golden age of piracy has come upon the toy world of Voxel! Pirates roam the seas, spending their days gathering treasure. Set sail into a world of great ships, secret bases, and port towns!
games.coop_description: Playable by 2-4 players. Work together to defeat giant sea monsters and enemy pirate ships!

games.title: Voyage
games.synopsis: To find their way home, two survivors journey to unravel the mysteries of the past. Voyage is an adventure game capturing the essence of shared exploration. Whether you decide to play by yourself or cooperatively, the journey will revolve around two survivors in search for answers of a long-forgotten past. Embark on a voyage, unravel a mystery and find a way home together.
games.coop_description: Two player couch co-op is supported throughout the campaign

games.title: Voyage
games.synopsis: To find their way home, two survivors journey to unravel the mysteries of the past. Voyage is an adventure game capturing the essence of shared exploration. Whether you decide to play by yourself or cooperatively, the journey will revolve around two survivors in search for answers of a long-forgotten past. Embark on a voyage, unravel a mystery and find a way home together.
games.coop_description: Two player couch co-op is supported throughout the campaign

games.title: WACKY! DEER & MUNK ADVENTURE
games.synopsis: WACKY! Deer & Munk Adventure is a 2D side-scrolling action adventure built for solo players and co-op chaos alike. Play as Deer and Munk, two completely different characters whose wildly unique abilities make every stage feel like a fresh challenge. The art style is hard to explain and impossible to forget: rough around the edges, full of personality, and weirdly, completely adorable. Think animated stickers come to life. Once it gets you, it does not let go.
games.coop_description: The game features a special co-op campaign separate from the solo storyline. Each player takes control of one of the characters with their different abilities. They need to work together to get through the game.

games.title: WHIP! WHIP!
games.synopsis: Tira the dessert hunter explores ruins to uncover the recipe required to revive a dessert from ages past. Ancient machines known as golems are also buried within these ruins. One day, Tira discovers a golem shaped like a mitten and finds out the legendary dessert she's been searching for is real. Head out in search of the legendary recipe!
games.coop_description: Two players can team up locally at any time during the campaign. Complete all 100 levels with two players to see the true ending! Fallen players can be revived by the other player.

games.title: WWE 2K BATTLEGROUNDS
games.synopsis: The world of WWE is your battleground with all-new, over the top, in-your-face arcade action as your favorite WWE Superstars and Legends battle it out in outlandish interactive environments around the world. Compete in your favorite match types with an arsenal of exaggerated maneuvers, special abilities, and devastating power-ups, including Steel Cage, Royal Rumble, Fatal Four Way and more, as Mauro Ranallo and Jerry “The King” Lawler call all the mayhem! Are you ready to enter the battleground?
games.coop_description: Two players can team up against the AI in all team modes like exhibition or steel cage matches.

games.title: WWE 2K22
games.synopsis: This edition of 2Ks WWE-Wrestling-Series features a redesigned gameplay engine and new controls as well as the addition of MyGM - a Manager mode.
games.coop_description: You can team up with a friend in team modes against the AI. The option to add AI is available once another player is in the lobby and you hover over the open slots. Until the servers were shut down on 12/31/23 this was also possible online.

games.title: WWE 2K23
games.synopsis: WWE 2K23 is Even Stronger with expanded features, gorgeous graphics and a deep roster of WWE Superstars and Legends. 2K Showcase returns as an interactive sports documentary focusing on the 20-year career of John Cena and WarGames is finally here!
games.coop_description: You can team up with a friend in team modes against the AI. The option to add AI is available once another player is in the lobby and you hover over the open slots.

games.title: Wake Up, Lia!
games.synopsis: Wake Up, Lia! is a narrative-driven 2D precision platformer set within nightmares shaped by bullying. As Lia, you will have to overcome deadly traps across 20 handcrafted stages to recover lost memories and fragments of your identity. Embark on a heartfelt journey of trauma, resilience and rebirth, blending emotional storytelling with challenging gameplay and an atmospheric soundtrack!
games.coop_description: Team up with a friend in local co-op. Local Co-Op Games

games.title: Wake Up, Lia!
games.synopsis: Wake Up, Lia! is a narrative-driven 2D precision platformer set within nightmares shaped by bullying. As Lia, you will have to overcome deadly traps across 20 handcrafted stages to recover lost memories and fragments of your identity. Embark on a heartfelt journey of trauma, resilience and rebirth, blending emotional storytelling with challenging gameplay and an atmospheric soundtrack!
games.coop_description: Team up with a friend in local co-op.

games.title: Wally and the FANTASTIC PREDATORS
games.synopsis: Wally and the FANTASTIC PREDATORS is a perma-death rogue-lite where you play as Wally, a predatory fox who is attacking defenseless animals in their own homes and taking all their money. During your decent you also get to experience verbal abuse from various NPCs, but it’s okay because you can hug the backpack guy and that’s fantastic.
games.coop_description: Backpack guy (or a copy of him?) can join you on your journey into the dungeon and help you survive - hopefully.

games.title: Waltz of the Wizard
games.synopsis: Experience magical powers in a world inspired by the atmosphere of films like Fantasia and Harry Potter! Combine arcane ingredients into a boiling cauldron with the help of an ancient talking skull, unleashing diverse wizardry with cutting-edge technologies like VOICE-INTERACTION AND GESTURES!
games.coop_description: At anytime you can team up with a friend on a second screen with a controller or mouse/keyboard. You can have some cozy magical times together mixing spells or solving riddles, and when you’re feeling adventurous, enter the Observer Fortress and battle behemoth stone creatures and discover some dark secrets.

games.title: Wand Wars
games.synopsis: Wand Wars is a fast-paced, top-down, magical sports game. Players ride brooms over ancient arenas, cast arcane spells and turn opponents into adorable chickens! Try to control a powerful magical sphere that bounces around the arena, increasing in speed and size over time. The game's epic stages, colorful characters and quirky powerups generate competitive gameplay that is incredibly fun to participate in and spectate. Hone your skills and uncover the magical universe of Wand Wars in Story Mode or battle your way through the unlimited chaos of The Trials. Play against up to 3 friends or the computer in 7 exciting multiplayer modes.
games.coop_description: The Trials (fight wave after wave of enemies) can be played with a second person on the couch.

games.title: War of Aero: Project MEIOU
games.synopsis: A vertically scrolling shoot'em up. The aircraft can be fitted with pods on either side, which can be turned around to shoot up and down.
games.coop_description: A second player can jump in at any time. When both aircrafts are stacked on top of each other, they merge to create a powerful attack.

games.title: Wargroove
games.synopsis: When war breaks out in the Kingdom of Cherrystone, the young Queen Mercia must flee her home. Pursued by her foes, the only way to save her kingdom is travel to new lands in search of allies. But who will she meet along the way, and what sinister challenges will she face?
games.coop_description: Local and online co-op play will be supported in the Skirmish mode where players can team up to take on AI opponents (i.e., "comp stomping"). As the Skirmish mode supports a max of four players, that means there can be, at most, three human players on one team against one A.I. opponent.

games.title: Wargroove 2
games.synopsis: Wargroove is back! Embark on an all-new adventure, filled with unlikely friendships, unknown adversaries, and ugly revenge plots. Wage war against your foes with a cast of new Commanders and utilise their new tiered ‘groove’ ability system to sway the fight in your favour. Design and share maps, cutscenes, and campaigns with easy-to-use editors and in-depth customization tools.
games.coop_description: Local and online co-op play is supported in the Skirmish mode where players can team up to take on AI opponents (i.e., "comp stomping"). As the Skirmish mode supports a max of four players, that means there can be, at most, three human players on one team against one A.I. opponent.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr Ultimate Edition
games.synopsis: The first Action-RPG set in the grim future of the 41st Millennium takes the genre to its next level: an open-world sandbox game with a persistent universe with a huge variety of missions, tactical, brutal combat encounters in destructible environments and a storyline influenced by the community of players. Use the cover system for tactical advantage, shoot off limbs and perform executions in epic boss battles and become a Protector of any solar systems with your glorious actions! The Ultimate Edition includes Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor – Martyr and all additional content: - The Prophecy expansion with a new class and campaign - A new ranked game mode - 12 new missions in unique game areas - 5 pets - 7 cosmetic items
games.coop_description: Play missions in co-operative mode with up to 4 team members, blast away your foes together claiming great rewards, and form Cabals to gather your close allies! Inquisitorial Cabals are groups of Inquisitors working together. Cabals can progress just like characters do, and being a member can often grant special missions. The console versions of Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr also support two player couch co-op. Since Patch 2.0 the whole Martyr campaign is playable in Co-Op except for the vehicular missions. Players must be at the same or higher progression level to start Campaign…

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & Teef
games.synopsis: Play as a savage warrior of the Green Tide, and become the spearhead of an Ork invasion as you bash, smash and shoot your way through the hive city of Luteus Prime on a mission to retrieve your hair squig and claim vengeance on your warlord! And just maybe become the warboss of a WAAAGH! along the way? Survival of the strongest has never been so violently fun! Scour the battlegrounds, defeat powerful bosses and collect teef to upgrade your arsenal and increase firepower!
games.coop_description: Blasting ‘umies is more fun when you do it together! Bring together four people, local or online, and fight through the hordes of guardsmen, genestealers, aberrants, intercessors, ratlings, … in this incredibly fun arcade-style co-op action mode!

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & Teef

games.title: Warhammer: Chaosbane Slayer Edition
games.synopsis: In a world ravaged by war and dominated by magic, you are the last hope for the Empire of Man against the Chaos hordes. From the sewers of Nuln to the ruined streets of Praag, fight your way through monster hordes using over 180 different powers. Fight over 70 monsters aligned with the Chaos Gods, including the minions of Nurgle, Khorne's spawn, and more. Four different character classes from which to choose: Empire Soldier, Dwarf Slayer, High Elf Mage, and a Wood Elf Waywatcher. In addition to the campaign mode, there's a boss rush mode and 10 different difficulty levels. The Slayer Edition includes all 12 downloadable content packs, every update including Keela the Dwarf Engineer, and the Tower of Chaos, all running in 4K resolution at 60 frames per second. It also includes a new character: Jurgen Haider the Witch Hunter.
games.coop_description: Play with up to 4 players via couch co-op, online co-op, or a mix of the two (combo co-op). The four different classes have abilities that can be combined to create even more devastating effects.

games.title: WarioWare: Get It Together!
games.synopsis: Take on over 200 quick and quirky microgames—lightning-fast minigames filled with frantic fun—solo or with a friend! When his latest harebrained business scheme goes awry, Wario must use his signature style (and smell) to fix it. How? By playing a twisted collection microgames of course! From assembling a robot to pulling out a statue’s armpit hair, the WarioWare™: Get It Together! game is a comedic, cooperative microgame mashup.
games.coop_description: Help out infamous game designer, Wario, after he gets sucked into his latest creation in Story Mode. Go it alone or with a friend in 2-player cooperative play—a first for the series! You can either play on the same system or via local wireless.

games.title: WarioWare: Move It!
games.synopsis: Grab a pair of Joy-Con controllers and get moving as you gently shake, punch, dance, wiggle, and even curtsey through over 200 lightning-fast microgames (minigames that last just a few hilarious seconds). A second player can use another set of Joy-Con controllers to join the treasure-guarding, sheep-twirling fun. Up to 4 players, each with one Joy-Con controller, can laugh out loud in the local Party Mode’s minigames like a dicey board game with Wario-style rules.
games.coop_description: A second player can use another set of Joy-Con controllers to join the treasure-guarding, sheep-twirling fun.

games.title: Warlocks 2: God Slayers
games.synopsis: In God Slayers you take on the role of one of the members of The Order of Warlocks. This time around you’ll have to face a much bigger threat than in the original game, Warlocks vs Shadows . By slashing hordes of shadow monsters in the past, Warlocks have angered the Gods, who now turned against them. As a result, you can now either give up, ask for mercy, and then quietly die, or you could release all your godlike powers instead and make the Gods pay for their betrayal. They’re not willing to go without a fight, though, and they’ll throw all kinds of opponents at you that will use any means necessary to take you down; and the giant bosses will put your skills to the test. Slay or get slain. There’s no other way.
games.coop_description: Four player couch co-op is supported throughout the campaign

games.title: Warrior Blade: Rastan Saga Episode III
games.synopsis: Complete the saga! Collect treasures throughout the land as Rastan, Sophia, or Dewey. Walk, ride, and even take flight in this thrilling action packed adventure! As opposed to the first two games, this time around the game is a beat 'em up.
games.coop_description: A second player can enter at any time and help with defeating all the enemies.

games.title: Warriors Orochi 4
games.synopsis: The world is merged once again. The re-assembled heroes are faced with yet another new battle. The key to solving this mysterious situation and returning the world back to normal are eight "bracelets" that possess great power. In search of these bracelets, the heroes clash against one another with their individual convictions. Before long it becomes apparent that Zeus, the king of the gods of Mount Olympus, is behind this. What is his aim in rebuilding this parallel world in which the heroes battled against Orochi? In order to solve this mystery, the heroes decide to battle against the gods. Choose from over 170 characters from the Dynasty Warrior and Samurai Warriors series. This latest fusion title features the inaugural appearance of Magic abilities, allowing characters to wield phenomenally powerful and visually impressive attacks against their most challenging foes. These new-found…
games.coop_description: Team up with a buddy locally or online to fight your way through the campaign, or play through missions in additional modes

games.title: Watcher Chronicles
games.synopsis: Become a glutton for punishment and persevere against 20+ merciless bosses and legions of skeletal nightmares in this savage yet charming 2D souls-like.
games.coop_description: Take on the entire game in local co-op with a friend! Single Joy-Con mode supported!

games.title: Watcher Chronicles
games.synopsis: Become a glutton for punishment and persevere against 20+ merciless bosses and legions of skeletal nightmares in this savage yet charming 2D souls-like.
games.coop_description: Take on the entire game in local co-op with a friend! Single Joy-Con mode supported!

games.title: Water Margin: A Tale of Clouds and Wind
games.synopsis: Fight the army of evil at the risk of your life! Play as one of the three heroes with specific moves and features, and face formidable warriors who will show no mercy. On your own or with a friend, slice through the woods and fight your way through hordes of enemies. Use different magics to put a large number of opponents at the same time. The end of the game will be different depending on the level of difficulty you choose.
games.coop_description: Another player can enter at any time choosing one of the remaining heroes and slice away with you.

games.title: We Could Be Heroes
games.synopsis: We Could Be Heroes is a retro style, action packed beat ‘em up in the style of classic 90s brawler arcade titles. Featuring a huge array of attacks, destructible environments and brutal deaths. Become a hero and fight bad guys while stopping crimes and rescuing innocent civilians along the way.
games.coop_description: Up to three additional player can jump in at any time and take control of one of the available characters.

games.title: We Love Katamari REROLL Plus Royal Reverie
games.synopsis: The King of the Cosmos once accidentally destroyed all the stars in the universe. He sent his son, the Prince, to Earth and ordered him to create a large katamari. The Prince rolled the katamari and made the katamari bigger and bigger, rolling up all the things on the earth. The katamari that he created floated in space, sparkling, and brought back the lost starry sky. As the starry sky was restored, the King's fans gradually grew in number all over the world. The King wanted to respond to the wishes of his fans for his success, and the Prince kept rolling the katamari to make everyone's dreams come true. •We Love Katamari Damacy has been powered up! We Love Katamari Damacy, the second title in the Katamari series released in 2005, has been remastered. The graphics have been completely redesigned, and the in-game UI has been revamped to make it even easier to play. •New additional…
games.coop_description: In co-op mode each player controls half of the katamari. You need to work together to get the ball where you want to. To compensate for the increased difficuly you get a bit of extra time.

games.title: Welcome to Empyreum
games.synopsis: Welcome to Empyreum is a local co-op party game up to 4 players . The main goal is to organize and clean numerous floors of the hotel with mechanics involving everyday chores (vacuuming or making the bed), and crazy tasks like taking care of alien babies and chasing ghosts away!
games.coop_description: Up to 4 players can work together in order to control the madness of the hotel. The better the coordination and communication of the team , the cleaner the rooms will be and, therefore, the happier the guests will be during their stay.

games.title: Welcome to Empyreum
